_what: where the dashcam failure lives, and the refutation of my per-type-retention hypothesis

my_hypothesis.claim: covex-v6-state sets max_offload_tokens = 0 for ALERT as well as single-shot, so dashcam KV is never retained; that frees KV for robot histories and would also deepen the dashcam deficit
my_hypothesis.refuted_by: the rung-1 against rung-2 dashcam comparison at both seeds. Rung 2 does not deepen the deficit; it roughly HALVES it. The hypothesis predicted the opposite sign

dashcam_outcomes._units: of 11,764 opportunities per cell: on time / sent but late / never sent

rung_2_improves_dashcam_over_rung_1.note: this holds at s4 EVEN WITH its 12,824 budget refusals, which is the stronger form of the result: the rung recovers dashcam over rung 1 while simultaneously starving it with touches

the_deficit_is_rung_1_s.reading: the dashcam failure is introduced at RUNG 1, by the covex-v6-rules lineage, and rung 2 partially recovers it. The fix lives in rung 1 and not in touch pricing, which is where I had ranked it

the_mechanism_that_now_needs_testing.candidate: STATE-BASED PRICING. v5-rules-2 charges a warm-ahead build C.recall_gpu_s(piece, 'COLD') whatever the session's predicted state is. Rung 2 charges touch_policy.build_price_gpu_s, which prices by PREDICTED TIER, so a build onto a GPU-warm prefix costs far less. Cheaper builds leave more budget, and dashcam monitors are what the budget was refusing
the_mechanism_that_now_needs_testing.why_it_is_credible: state pricing is already the SOLE cause of rung 2's dry-cell difference from rung 1, by one-factor ablation (v6state_attribution.json). The same switch explaining the live dashcam recovery would be one mechanism, not two
the_mechanism_that_now_needs_testing.the_test: covex-v6-state-noprice at s5; if dashcam falls back towards 1,219 on time, settled
the_mechanism_that_now_needs_testing.register: NOT ESTABLISHED. This is a hypothesis with a named test, exactly as the refuted one was, and it must not be reported as the explanation until the cell runs

what_this_does_not_change: rung 2 is still far below the base on dashcam, 2,458 against 5,540 at s5. Halving a deficit is not closing it, and no cell of this rung may be read as dashcam-neutral
